explication: ORT is a FOSS policy automation toolkit for analyzing software dependencies, gathering source and scan data, assessing risk and policy, and producing reports or notifications. The documented workflow is modular: Analyzer resolves dependency metadata; Downloader retrieves source; Scanner finds license and copyright evidence; Advisor gathers vulnerability information; Evaluator applies policy; Reporter and Notifier present or distribute results. README statements support the stage relationships; the sampled sources chiefly establish domain-model and selected integration responsibilities, so unsampled implementation links are not asserted.
